task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, make an effort to head east. With that over with, venture south. After that, open the gate within the laundry place. Then, attempt to go west. Next, open the portal. And then, try to move west. Following that, ensure that the gateway is open. And then, attempt to go to the south. With that accomplished, go to the east. And then, recover the apple from the mantle in the studio. Got that? Good!
